summary: Launch video for the Sweeply CLI tool demonstrating disk cleanup and git safety status, generated with Claude Opus 5.5 and the /brag command from the code repository.

post.originalText:
opus 5.5 + /brag made this launch video for sweeply from the repo alone. sweeply finds the node_modules, .next, venv and dist rotting in your old projects and deletes them, with a git light so you know what's safe.
 https://t.co/A3VdZDb880
https://t.co/fynqjoTVRP https://t.co/wiXqP88GgC
